description: ISO 11649 creditor reference. RF, two check digits, then up to 21 letters or digits. Spaces, hyphens, dots, commas, slashes and colons are ignored. The check moves RF and the two digits to the end and requires ISO 7064 mod 97-10 to be 1. This does not look the creditor up. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/creditor-ref
